autoBackupPolicy: Runs once daily after unlock when the vault has changed.
cloudDescription: Connect a personal backup destination for encrypted snapshots.
cloudPosition: Cloud storage is a disaster-recovery copy, not a sync service.
credentialsBoundary: Only the encrypted backup file is stored in cloud storage; your master password and plaintext DEK are never uploaded.
exportDescription: Create and download an encrypted vault backup.
exportDialogDescription: Enter your master password and recovery key. They are used only for this export and never stored.
exportInvalidRecoveryKey: The recovery key is invalid (24 words).
exportVaultLocked: Unlock the vault first to export.
importDescription: Import CSV or an unencrypted Bitwarden JSON file; preview data stays in browser memory.
importFileModifiedAt: Import file modified {{date}}. Choose manually; freshness is never guessed.
importFileTimeUnknown: The import file has no modification time, so its age cannot be determined. Choose manually.
importWriteUnavailable: Import writes are unavailable because no authenticated vault-write adapter is connected.
integrityNotChecked: Container shape recognized only; authenticity and integrity have not been checked.
localImportDescription: Parse and preview an import file locally before applying it.
mappingDescription: Map each required field to its CSV column. Optional fields can be left blank.
passwordDiffers: Password differs for “{{name}}”. Choose what to do.
passwordsMasked: Passwords are hidden in the preview.
restoreDescription: Choose an encrypted backup to inspect its container.
restoreUnavailable: Restore is unavailable because this client has no Argon2id, DEK-decryption, or vault-write adapter.
secretBoundary: Only encrypted vault data is stored in backup files; never include passwords or DEKs in filenames.
sourceFileReminder: After import, delete the original source file from your device.

errors.futureVersion: This backup format is newer than this client supports.
errors.invalidContainer: The backup file has an invalid or unsupported structure.

webdavInsecureWarning: Plain HTTP sends your password unencrypted. Only use it for a local NAS or loopback address.
